package smb

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/authz"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/metastore"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
)

type diagnosticControlProof struct {
	released  atomic.Int32
	validated atomic.Int32
	check     func(context.Context) error
	onRelease func()
}

func (p *diagnosticControlProof) Release() {
	if p.onRelease != nil {
		p.onRelease()
	}
	p.released.Add(1)
}
func (p *diagnosticControlProof) Validate(ctx context.Context, root uint64, position metastore.Position, filter uint32, recursive bool, events []wire.Notification) error {
	p.validated.Add(1)
	if p.released.Load() != 0 || root != 1 || position != 1 || filter != 1 || !recursive || !reflect.DeepEqual(events, []wire.Notification{{Action: 2, Name: "gone"}}) {
		return syscall.ESTALE
	}
	if p.check != nil {
		return p.check(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

type diagnosticControlStream struct {
	*notifyTestStream
	proof     DiagnosticNotificationProof
	retainErr error
	retained  atomic.Int32
}

func (s *diagnosticControlStream) RetainNotificationProof(metastore.Change) (DiagnosticNotificationProof, error) {
	s.retained.Add(1)
	return s.proof, s.retainErr
}
func diagnosticControlManager(t *testing.T, stream *diagnosticControlStream) *notificationManager {
	t.Helper()
	source := testNotifySource(stream.notifyTestStream)
	source.Subscribe = func(context.Context) (ChangeStream, error) { return stream, nil }
	m, err := newNotificationManager(t.Context(), source, DefaultLimits())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := m.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	return m
}
func diagnosticWaitPosition(t *testing.T, m *notificationManager) {
	t.Helper()
	waitNotify(t, func() bool { m.mu.Lock(); defer m.mu.Unlock(); return m.position == 1 })
}
func TestDiagnosticNotificationQueueOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"consume", "provider-error", "proof-error", "disclosure-error", "missing-disclosure", "cancel-rearm", "remove", "close", "overflow", "ordinary"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			proof := &diagnosticControlProof{}
			stream := &diagnosticControlStream{notifyTestStream: testNotifyStream(), proof: proof}
			if name == "provider-error" {
				stream.retainErr = syscall.EACCES
			}
			if name == "proof-error" {
				proof.check = func(context.Context) error { return syscall.ESTALE }
			}
			if name == "ordinary" {
				stream.proof = nil
			}
			m := diagnosticControlManager(t, stream)
			proof.onRelease = func() {
				unlocked := make(chan struct{})
				go func() { m.mu.Lock(); m.mu.Unlock(); close(unlocked) }()
				select {
				case <-unlocked:
				case <-time.After(time.Second):
					t.Error("proof released under manager lock")
				}
			}
			if name == "overflow" {
				m.limits.MaxNotifyEvents = 0
			}
			var ordinary, disclosures atomic.Int32
			validate := func(context.Context, storage.EntryLocation) error { ordinary.Add(1); return nil }
			disclose := func(context.Context, storage.EntryLocation) error {
				disclosures.Add(1)
				if name == "disclosure-error" {
					return authz.ErrDenied
				}
				return nil
			}
			if name == "missing-disclosure" {
				disclose = nil
			}
			registered, release := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
			defer cancel()
			result := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() {
				_, err := m.watchDiagnostic(ctx, "watch", notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 4096, func() error { close(registered); <-release; return nil }, validate, disclose)
				result <- err
			}()
			select {
			case <-registered:
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
				t.Fatal("watch not registered")
			}
			stream.changes <- namedChange(1, metastore.Removed, "gone", 0)
			diagnosticWaitPosition(t, m)
			switch name {
			case "cancel-rearm":
				cancel()
			case "remove":
				m.remove("watch")
			case "close":
				if err := m.Close(); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			close(release)
			var err error
			select {
			case err = <-result:
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
				t.Fatal("watch did not return")
			}
			switch name {
			case "consume", "ordinary":
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			case "cancel-rearm":
				if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || proof.released.Load() != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("cancel lost buffered group: %v released=%d", err, proof.released.Load())
				}
				events, nextErr := m.watchDiagnostic(t.Context(), "watch", notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 4096, nil, validate, disclose)
				if nextErr != nil || len(events) != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("rearm: %v %v", events, nextErr)
				}
			default:
				if err == nil {
					t.Fatal("failure returned success")
				}
			}
			wantRelease := int32(1)
			if name == "overflow" || name == "ordinary" {
				wantRelease = 0
			}
			if proof.released.Load() != wantRelease {
				t.Fatalf("release=%d want=%d", proof.released.Load(), wantRelease)
			}
			if name == "ordinary" {
				if ordinary.Load() != 1 || disclosures.Load() != 0 {
					t.Fatal("ordinary path changed")
				}
			} else if ordinary.Load() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("historical proof failure fell back")
			}
			if name == "proof-error" && disclosures.Load() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("failed proof disclosed names")
			}
			if name == "overflow" && stream.retained.Load() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("retained before budget admission")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticNotificationClosePinsValidation(t *testing.T) {
	proof := &diagnosticControlProof{}
	entered, allowReturn := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	proof.check = func(ctx context.Context) error { close(entered); <-ctx.Done(); <-allowReturn; return ctx.Err() }
	stream := &diagnosticControlStream{notifyTestStream: testNotifyStream(), proof: proof}
	m := diagnosticControlManager(t, stream)
	proof.onRelease = func() {
		unlocked := make(chan struct{})
		go func() { m.mu.Lock(); m.mu.Unlock(); close(unlocked) }()
		select {
		case <-unlocked:
		case <-time.After(time.Second):
			t.Error("proof released under manager lock")
		}
	}
	registered := make(chan struct{})
	result := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		_, err := m.watchDiagnostic(t.Context(), "watch", notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 4096, func() error { close(registered); return nil }, notificationTestProof, notificationTestProof)
		result <- err
	}()
	<-registered
	stream.changes <- namedChange(1, metastore.Removed, "gone", 0)
	<-entered
	closed := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { closed <- m.Close() }()
	select {
	case <-stream.done:
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("close did not unblock stream")
	}
	if proof.released.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("close released an actively validated proof")
	}
	select {
	case err := <-closed:
		t.Fatalf("close did not drain validation: %v", err)
	default:
	}
	close(allowReturn)
	select {
	case <-result:
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("validation did not drain")
	}
	select {
	case err := <-closed:
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("close did not finish")
	}
	if proof.released.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("release=%d", proof.released.Load())
	}
}

type diagnosticSyncFile struct {
	storage.File
	err error
}

func (f diagnosticSyncFile) Sync(context.Context) error { return f.err }
func TestDiagnosticNotificationDisclosure(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"removed-leaf", "retain-denied", "list-denied", "watch-list-denied", "sync-denied", "sync-outage", "missing-ancestor", "changed-ancestor", "moved-ancestor", "collision", "invalid-sibling", "list-outage", "observation-race", "no-list-access"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			session, _, root, parent, child := newClientTestSession(t)
			old := child.observation.Location.Clone()
			parent.entries = nil
			parent.observation.Attr.DirectoryRevision++
			parent.observation.Attr.MetadataRevision++
			file := &clientFile{session: session, raw: diagnosticSyncFile{File: root}, access: windowsReadData}
			switch name {
			case "retain-denied", "list-denied", "watch-list-denied", "sync-denied":
				session.backend.authorize = authz.AuthorizerFunc(func(_ context.Context, r authz.AccessRequest) error {
					if name == "retain-denied" && r.Operation == storage.OpFileRetain || name == "list-denied" && r.Operation == storage.OpFileListAt && r.Node == 2 || name == "watch-list-denied" && r.Operation == storage.OpFileListAt && r.Node == 1 || name == "sync-denied" && r.Operation == storage.OpFileSync {
						return authz.ErrDenied
					}
					return nil
				})
			case "sync-outage":
				file.raw = diagnosticSyncFile{File: root, err: syscall.EIO}
			case "missing-ancestor":
				root.entries = nil
			case "changed-ancestor":
				root.entries[0].EntryID++
			case "moved-ancestor":
				parent.observation.Location.Ancestors[0].Name = []byte("Elsewhere")
			case "collision":
				parent.entries = []storage.DirectoryEntry{{EntryID: 8, Name: []byte("Foo"), Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 8}}, {EntryID: 9, Name: []byte("foo"), Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 9}}}
			case "invalid-sibling":
				parent.entries = []storage.DirectoryEntry{{EntryID: 8, Name: []byte("bad:name"), Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 8}}}
			case "list-outage":
				parent.onList = func(storage.DirectoryPageRequest) (storage.DirectoryPage, error) {
					return storage.DirectoryPage{}, syscall.EIO
				}
			case "observation-race":
				parent.checkErr = syscall.EAGAIN
			case "no-list-access":
				file.access = windowsReadAttributes
			}
			err := file.ValidateDiagnosticNotification(t.Context(), old)
			if name == "removed-leaf" {
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if len(parent.lists) != 1 || parent.lists[0].Revision != 42 {
					t.Fatalf("not using current revision: %v", parent.lists)
				}
				if err := file.ValidateNotificationLocation(t.Context(), old); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("ordinary current leaf guard was weakened")
				}
			} else if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid current disclosure accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticNotificationRetirementWhileValidating(t *testing.T) {
	for _, kind := range []string{"remove", "stream-error", "cancel-rearm"} {
		t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			proof := &diagnosticControlProof{}
			entered, proceed := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
			proof.check = func(context.Context) error {
				if proof.validated.Load() == 1 {
					close(entered)
					<-proceed
				}
				return nil
			}
			stream := &diagnosticControlStream{notifyTestStream: testNotifyStream(), proof: proof}
			m := diagnosticControlManager(t, stream)
			proof.onRelease = func() {
				unlocked := make(chan struct{})
				go func() { m.mu.Lock(); m.mu.Unlock(); close(unlocked) }()
				select {
				case <-unlocked:
				case <-time.After(time.Second):
					t.Error("proof released under manager lock")
				}
			}
			registered := make(chan struct{})
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
			defer cancel()
			result := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() {
				_, err := m.watchDiagnostic(ctx, "watch", notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 4096, func() error { close(registered); return nil }, notificationTestProof, notificationTestProof)
				result <- err
			}()
			<-registered
			stream.changes <- namedChange(1, metastore.Removed, "gone", 0)
			<-entered
			switch kind {
			case "remove":
				m.remove("watch")
			case "stream-error":
				stream.failures <- syscall.EIO
				waitNotify(t, func() bool { m.mu.Lock(); defer m.mu.Unlock(); return m.failure != nil })
			case "cancel-rearm":
				cancel()
			}
			if proof.released.Load() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("retirement released active proof")
			}
			close(proceed)
			select {
			case err := <-result:
				if err == nil {
					t.Fatal("retired request succeeded")
				}
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
				t.Fatal("validation did not retire")
			}
			if kind == "cancel-rearm" {
				if proof.released.Load() != 0 {
					t.Fatal("wait cancellation destroyed buffered proof")
				}
				if _, err := m.watchDiagnostic(t.Context(), "watch", notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 4096, nil, notificationTestProof, notificationTestProof); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			if proof.released.Load() != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("release=%d", proof.released.Load())
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticNotificationCloseDrainsDiscard(t *testing.T) {
	proof := &diagnosticControlProof{}
	entered, proceed := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	proof.onRelease = func() { close(entered); <-proceed }
	stream := &diagnosticControlStream{notifyTestStream: testNotifyStream(), proof: proof}
	m := diagnosticControlManager(t, stream)
	registered := make(chan struct{})
	result := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		_, err := m.watchDiagnostic(t.Context(), "watch", notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 1, func() error { close(registered); return nil }, notificationTestProof, notificationTestProof)
		result <- err
	}()
	<-registered
	stream.changes <- namedChange(1, metastore.Removed, "gone", 0)
	<-entered
	closed := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { closed <- m.Close() }()
	select {
	case <-stream.done:
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("source not closed")
	}
	select {
	case <-closed:
		t.Fatal("close returned before detached release")
	default:
	}
	close(proceed)
	select {
	case err := <-result:
		if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotifyRescan) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("discard did not finish")
	}
	select {
	case err := <-closed:
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("close did not drain release")
	}
	if proof.released.Load() != 1 || proof.validated.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("release=%d validation=%d", proof.released.Load(), proof.validated.Load())
	}
}
